여기.x: This is the school I go to.
여기.e: Same 이/그/저 pattern: 여기 (here), 거기 (there), 저기 (over there).
여기.t: 여기요! is also a common way to call a waiter in a restaurant.

젓가락.e: 저 (Sino-Korean for chopsticks) + ㅅ + 가락 (thin stick), like 숟가락 and 손가락.
젓가락.t: Pronounced [저까락] or [젇까락]. Korean chopsticks are usually metal and flat.

그림.x: My younger sibling drew a picture of a cat.
그림.t: 'Draw a picture' = 그림을 그리다. A photo is 사진, not 그림.

일어나다.m: to get up, to wake up; to stand up; to happen
일어나다.x: I get up at seven every day.
일어나다.e: 일다 (rise) + 나다 (come out) — 'rise up': wake up, stand up, or happen.
일어나다.t: Pronounced [이러나다]: the ㄹ batchim links to the next vowel.

멀다.x: It's a bit far from home to the office.
멀다.e: ㄹ drops before ㄴ: 먼 곳 (a far place). Opposite: 가깝다.
멀다.t: Common pattern: A에서 B까지 멀어요 = It's far from A to B.

호주.x: Australia's seasons are the opposite of Korea's, so December is summer.
호주.e: Shortened from an old character spelling of 'Australia' plus 'continent'; the syllables don't help.
호주.t: The English name 오스트레일리아 exists too, but everyday Korean almost always uses 호주.

빨래하다.m: to do the laundry, to wash clothes
빨래하다.x: The weather was nice, so I did the laundry this morning.
빨래하다.e: 빨래 (laundry) comes from 빨다 'to wash clothes'.
빨래하다.t: 빨래 means both the washing and the clothes themselves: 빨래를 널다 = to hang out the laundry.

께서.forms: Honorific subject particle; replaces 이/가 after a respected person: 할머니께서; topic: 께서는
께서.ex: 우리 할아버지께서는 매일 아침 신문을 읽으세요.
께서.x: My grandfather reads the newspaper every morning.
께서.t: Pair 께서 with the honorific -(으)시- verb ending: 아버지께서 오셨어요.

손해.ex: 이번 일로 회사가 큰 손해를 봤어요.
손해.x: The company took a big loss because of this.
손해.t: The key collocation is 손해를 보다, 'to take a loss' — not 손해를 하다.

가스.ex: 외출하기 전에 가스 불을 꼭 끄세요.
가스.x: Be sure to turn off the gas stove before going out.
가스.e: From English 'gas'; it means fuel gas, never gasoline, which is 휘발유.
가스.t: A gas stove is 가스레인지, from Konglish 'gas range.'

점검하다.x: I checked the car carefully before the trip.
점검하다.e: Literally 'tick off and examine' — check item by item.
점검하다.t: 점검하다 is checking for problems in machines or systems; 확인하다 is just confirming a fact.

영양제.x: I've been tired lately, so I take supplements every morning.

체류.ex: 외국인은 체류 기간이 끝나기 전에 비자를 연장해야 해요.
체류.x: Foreigners must extend their visa before their period of stay ends.
체류.t: Mostly in official contexts: 체류 기간, 체류 자격 'visa status'.

포기.x: Even if studying gets hard, don't give up halfway.
포기.t: A different native word 포기 counts heads of cabbage: 배추 한 포기.

구별하다.x: They're twins, so it's hard to tell them apart.
구별하다.t: 구별하다 is telling things apart by their differences; 구분하다 is sorting things into groups.

조화.ex: 이 방은 색깔의 조화가 정말 좋아요.
조화.x: The colors in this room go together really well.
조화.e: Literally 'tuned into harmony', like instruments playing together.
조화.t: Homonym warning: 조화 can also mean 'artificial flower' (a different word).

주가.x: The stock price rose as soon as the good news came out.

신분.ex: 옛날에는 신분에 따라 할 수 있는 일이 달랐어요.
신분.x: In the old days, the work you could do depended on your social status.
신분.t: 신분증 = ID card: 신분증 좀 보여 주세요 = Please show me your ID.

응답자.x: More than half of the respondents answered 'yes.'

추세.ex: 최근 결혼을 늦게 하는 추세가 계속되고 있어요.
추세.x: Recently, the trend of marrying later has continued.
추세.e: Literally 'the force things are moving toward'.
추세.t: Common phrases: 증가 추세 'rising trend', 감소 추세 'falling trend'; for fashion fads use 유행.

논란.ex: 그 배우의 발언이 큰 논란이 되었어요.
논란.x: The actor's comment became a big controversy.
논란.t: Pronounced [놀란]: ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ. Common: 논란이 되다 'to become controversial'.

심장병.ex: 담배를 많이 피우면 심장병에 걸리기 쉬워요.
심장병.x: If you smoke a lot, you're more likely to get heart disease.

근면하다.x: He is a diligent and conscientious employee at the company.
근면하다.t: More formal than 부지런하다; common in writing, résumés and speeches.

떠올리다.m: to recall, to think of, to bring to mind
떠올리다.ex: 그 사진을 보면 항상 고향을 떠올려요.
떠올리다.x: Whenever I see that photo, I think of my hometown.
떠올리다.e: 뜨다 'to float' + 올리다 'to raise': floating a memory up to mind.
떠올리다.t: 떠오르다 = an idea pops up by itself; 떠올리다 = you call it up.

무사하다.x: There was an accident, but the whole family is safe.

고진감래.m: after hardship comes joy; no pain, no gain
고진감래.ex: 고진감래라고, 열심히 하면 좋은 날이 올 거예요.
고진감래.x: As they say, after the bitter comes the sweet; if you work hard, good days will come.
고진감래.e: Literally 'when the bitter is used up, the sweet arrives'.
고진감래.t: Pronounced [고진감내] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅁ.

최애.x: My favorite in this group is the youngest member.
최애.t: Casual fan slang. Your second favorite is 차애 (次愛 'next love').

몰아보다.m: to binge-watch, to watch many episodes at once
몰아보다.x: I binge-watched all the drama episodes I'd missed over the weekend.
몰아보다.e: 몰다 'to herd, gather together' + 보다 'to watch'.
몰아보다.t: Also written 몰아 보다. Same pattern: 몰아서 하다 'to do it all at once'.

브이로그.ex: 제 일상을 담은 브이로그를 찍어서 올리고 있어요.
브이로그.x: I film and upload vlogs about my daily life.
브이로그.e: From English 'vlog' (video + blog); the v is spelled out as 브이.
브이로그.t: Popular kinds: 일상 브이로그 (daily life), 여행 브이로그 (travel), 직장인 브이로그 (office worker's day). Make one: 브이로그를 찍다.

논설위원.ex: 그는 신문사 논설위원으로 이십 년 동안 일했어요.
논설위원.x: He worked as an editorial writer at a newspaper for twenty years.

출토.ex: 이 오래된 무덤에서 신라 시대의 금관이 출토되었습니다.
출토.x: A Silla-era gold crown was unearthed from this old tomb.
출토.t: 발굴 is the act of digging; 출토 is the object coming out: 유물이 출토되다.

근대.ex: 이 건물은 한국 근대 건축의 대표적인 예입니다.
근대.x: This building is a classic example of modern Korean architecture.
근대.t: 근대 is the early modern era (in Korea, roughly the late 1800s to 1945); 현대 is today's era.

분단.x: The Korean Peninsula has been divided into North and South since 1945.

과밀.ex: 정부는 수도권 인구 과밀 문제를 해결하려고 합니다.
과밀.x: The government is trying to solve the overpopulation problem in the capital region.

전개하다.m: to develop, to unfold, to lay out (a story, argument); to deploy
전개하다.x: He laid out his argument logically.
전개하다.e: Literally 'unfold and open' — spreading an idea out step by step.
전개하다.t: Use 전개되다 when a story or situation unfolds by itself: 사건이 빠르게 전개되다.

모름지기.m: by all means, as a matter of course, ought to
모름지기.ex: 학생은 모름지기 공부를 열심히 해야 합니다.
모름지기.x: Students ought to study hard, as a matter of course.
모름지기.e: Looks like 모르다 'not know', but it means 'ought to' — don't be fooled.
모름지기.t: Pairs with -아/어야 하다 to state what a kind of person should do.

저널리즘.ex: 가짜 뉴스가 많아지면서 좋은 저널리즘이 더 중요해졌어요.
저널리즘.x: With so much fake news, good journalism has become more important.

주관.m: subjectivity, one's own views; personal judgment
주관.ex: 그는 자기 주관이 뚜렷해서 남의 말에 쉽게 흔들리지 않아요.
주관.x: He has clear views of his own, so he isn't easily swayed by others.
주관.e: Literally 'the self's view'; opposite of 객관 'the guest's view'.
주관.t: Homonym 주관 means 'organizing, hosting' (an event); context makes it clear.

혼례.ex: 한옥 마을에서 전통 혼례를 올리는 부부를 봤어요.
혼례.x: At the hanok village, I saw a couple holding a traditional wedding.
혼례.t: Pronounced [홀례] — ㄴ becomes ㄹ before ㄹ. Used with 올리다: 혼례를 올리다.

심포지엄.ex: 다음 달에 서울에서 국제 심포지엄이 열립니다.
심포지엄.x: An international symposium will be held in Seoul next month.

꿍꿍이.m: secret scheme, something someone is up to
꿍꿍이.ex: 저 사람 무슨 꿍꿍이가 있는지 모르겠어요.
꿍꿍이.x: I don't know what that person is up to.
꿍꿍이.e: Probably related to 꿍꿍 'quietly brooding' sounds; casual and slightly negative.
꿍꿍이.t: Casual word; 무슨 꿍꿍이야? means 'What are you scheming?' and sounds playful or suspicious.

회계감사.x: An outside firm conducts an audit every year.
회계감사.t: 감사 'audit' sounds like 감사 'thanks' (감사합니다) — totally different words.

보궐선거.ex: 의원이 사퇴하면서 그 지역에서 보궐선거가 열립니다.
보궐선거.x: Because the lawmaker resigned, a by-election will be held in that area.
보궐선거.t: 재선거 reruns an election that was declared void.

모더니즘.ex: 1930년대 한국 시에도 모더니즘이 큰 영향을 주었어요.
모더니즘.x: Modernism also had a big influence on Korean poetry in the 1930s.

재연.ex: 그 뮤지컬은 관객들의 요청으로 내년에 재연이 결정되었어요.
재연.x: Due to audience demand, the musical's revival has been confirmed for next year.
재연.t: Don't confuse with 재현 (reproduction, re-creation); 재연 is for restaged shows and staged reenactments.

고분.ex: 경주 시내에는 신라 시대의 큰 고분들이 있어요.
고분.x: Downtown Gyeongju has large tombs from the Silla period.

두문불출.m: shutting oneself in, staying at home and not going out
두문불출.ex: 그는 시험 준비를 위해 한 달 동안 두문불출했어요.
두문불출.x: He shut himself in for a month to prepare for the exam.
두문불출.e: Literally 'shut the gate and don't go out.'

분출하다.m: to erupt, to spew, to gush out; to burst out (emotions, demands)
분출하다.t: Also figurative: 불만이 분출하다 = discontent bursts out.

유린하다.x: The dictatorship trampled on the people's human rights.
유린하다.t: 인권 유린 'human rights abuse' is the most common collocation.

지새우다.ex: 시험 준비 때문에 어젯밤을 꼬박 지새웠어요.
지새우다.x: I stayed up all last night preparing for the exam.
지새우다.e: Contains 새우다 'to stay up until dawn' — think of 날이 새다 'day breaks'.
지새우다.t: Almost always with 밤: 밤을 지새우다; the everyday version is 밤을 새우다.

빼어나다.x: This area is famous for its outstanding scenery.
빼어나다.e: Probably 빼다 (to pull out) + 나다: pulled out from the crowd.

관포지교.ex: 두 할아버지는 평생 관포지교를 나눈 사이입니다.
관포지교.x: The two grandfathers shared a lifelong friendship.
관포지교.e: Named after Guan Zhong and Bao Shuya, ancient Chinese friends who trusted each other completely.

재정건전성.ex: 정부는 재정건전성을 높이기 위해 지출을 줄였습니다.
재정건전성.x: The government cut spending to improve fiscal soundness.
재정건전성.t: -성 turns a noun into '-ness' or '-ity': 안전성 (safety), 가능성 (possibility).
